subject: [RFC PATCH 6/6] mm/page_alloc: let the bulk allocator carry alloc_flags

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new function __alloc_pages_bulk_noprof() in the Linux kernel's page allocation module, which allows callers to specify allocator behavior flags. The existing alloc_pages_bulk_noprof() function is modified to use this new function and pass default flags. This change enables internal MM callers to select specific behaviors through the bulk interface, addressing a limitation in the original implementation.
